 Coordination ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
  COORDINATION  feature-live                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                           
  This head is a single agent session. Coordination between heads matters when several heads work in the same project: claims (files a     
  head intends to change), scopes (areas it stays within), a shared work queue and allocated resources let Hydra flag overlap early. For   
  example, two heads that both claim lib/ are reported before they conflict. A workflow adds steps, dependencies and handoffs on top.
